# wikijs_api (Resource)

The `wikijs_api` Resource implements the WikiJS API mutation `authentication{setApiState{…}}`.
With that you can enable or disable the API endpoint.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "wikijs_api" "api" {
  enabled = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the Wiki.JS API.
